meta.name: gget
meta.description: Fast CLI/Python queries to 20+ bioinformatics databases. Use for quick lookups: gene info, BLAST/BLAT, viral sequence downloads, AlphaFold structures, enrichment analysis, OpenTargets, COSMIC, CELLxGENE, and 8cube mouse specificity/expression data. Best for interactive exploration and simple queries. For batch processing or advanced BLAST use biopython; for multi-database Python workflows use bioservices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取基因、序列与蛋白结构等生物数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要快速查询基因、序列和结构等生物数据
copy.tagline_en: Query gene, sequence, and structure data from 20+ bio databases.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need quick lookups of gene, sequence, and protein structure data in bio research.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可通过命令行或 Python 查询 20 多个生物信息数据库，做基因信息、序列获取、BLAST/BLAT 比对、AlphaFold 结构预测、表达与疾病数据等查询，结果默认返回 JSON、CSV 或 DataFrame。
howto.when: 当你要做基因或蛋白的快速查询与探索性分析时使用，例如查基因信息、跑 BLAST/BLAT、下载病毒序列、取 AlphaFold 结构等；批量处理请改用 biopython，多数据库 Python 流程用 bioservices。

say.text: 用 gget 查一下人类 ACE2 的相关基因
say.note: 返回 100 个最相关基因及相关系数

say.text: 用 gget blast 比对一下这段蛋白序列
say.note: 默认比对 nr 数据库，最多返回 50 条命中

say.text: 用 gget cellxgene 取肺组织中 ACE2 的单细胞数据

howto.what_en: gget lets Claude query 20+ bioinformatics databases via CLI or Python: gene info, sequences, BLAST/BLAT, AlphaFold structures, expression and disease data. Results return as JSON, CSV or DataFrames.
howto.when_en: Use for quick gene or protein lookups: gene info, BLAST/BLAT, viral sequence downloads, AlphaFold structures. For batch processing use biopython; for multi-database Python workflows use bioservices.

say_en.text: Use gget to look up genes correlated with human ACE2
say_en.note: Returns 100 most correlated genes with coefficients

say_en.text: Use gget blast to align this protein sequence
say_en.note: Searches nr by default, up to 50 hits

say_en.text: Use gget cellxgene to fetch ACE2 single-cell data in lung
